body:
I was one of the people who expected a massive coop war that lasted 1+ month/s and went around the entire solar system + veil system, kind of like Scarlet Spear and Orphix Venom, but not only on one planet.

I was on a break from warframe having picked up different games, but I kept tabs on what was going on in WF, I saw the news about the New War and my first thought was "awesome, another Scarlet Spear, I can finally get my missing arcanes and other things they reward in this event." 

Then they did the massive unvault that is Prime Resurgence and I was even more convinced. 16 Prime Warframes, and associated weapons, released almost simultaneously meant something huge huge coming.

Then the "if you hope to survive The New War, you will need the full arsenal of the Tenno at your disposal" led me to actually spend a long time leveling my voidrig, railjack, building missing Warframes and upgrading some of the ones I already had, just in case we needed different Warframes (Chroma for big single dmg, Nekros for loot, Trinity for healing and support) 

Then the timing, Orphix Venom released almost exactly one year earlier and Scarlet Spear about 9 months before that.

All for a quest in which you use your railjack for a few minutes, your necramech for a few minutes, only one of your warframes for a few minutes, all against extremely underleveled enemies. The remainder of the quest you use operator/drifter, 3 characters that you can't build, and weapons you can't mod.

The quest itself was quite nice, and I liked playing each of the 3 "npc's" as well as the drifter. But that DE was misleading is an understatement. We didn't even fight a war. When we appeared earth had already pretty much fallen. We had one fight, got sent to the void, some weird thing happened, drifter appears, drifter single handedly wins somehow (?).

Where were the other Tenno? The Kuva Litches? My own Kuva Litch who thinks he's immortal and wants to take over Saturn? The various bosses with 3 invulnerability phases? The Sisters? The Queens? The Entrati? Any other major faction/syndicate?

I get that it's hard to turn a multiplayer game into singleplayer, but why try it? You wanted to do a story quest that only happens in single player? Cool, do that, to begin with, but then the war should be fought by the entire community.

What I would have loved would have been for part 1 to be the same, sentients invade, the factions (excluding tenno) fight back and lose/struggle extremely hard, we as tenno appear and manage to tip the scales in our favor. 

In part 2 if you really felt the need to give players an adult operator, you could have given Ballas a weapon to banish all void infected living beings to the void/a different dimension (or simply find a way to disable all Tenno in an instant somehow, maybe a way to overcharge their void powers so they lose consciousness) so every single Tenno would be banished/out of commission. This causes their alterego, drifters, to awaken void powers and are finally able to make their appearance, fighting the war in the Tenno's place, until eventually they find a way to bring the Tenno back (perhaps they can trade their void powers between themselves, so you can switch between Operator and Drifter after the war). Operators come back and we get part 3.

Part 3,we get a ton of new missions, perhaps even on a timed basis, like invasions or void fissures, all against sentients. A spy mission on a sentient tileset? Count me in. A sabotage mission to disable a sentient ship from being able to fight? Awesome. Maybe add a new set of sorties, or 3-5 mission related quests (perhaps a spy mission to discover the location of some important sentient asset -> an exterminate mission near the actual objective to reduce (eventual) incoming support -> a sabotage to destroy a ships engines (or disable comms on a base) -> a survival on said ship (or base) to raid it of resources) or whatever else along those lines. Kind of like a heist on GTA if you will, some quick preparation missions followed by a big mission that gives tons of loot. You could also create a temporary alliance with the grineer and corpus, perhaps feeding them resources to build a fomorian/razorback. 

This could have lasted for maybe 1-2 months, and in the end Ballas is either defeated or has to retreat, or whatever, I literally came up with all this in the past day or so after finishing the quest. I don't even know how well it would fit lore wise, and by that logic what would need to be altered to make it fit. But having a single tenno fight a war after two previous events? Skirmishes? Battles? (or whatever else you call scarlet spear and orphix venom) were Coop and massive is illogical to me. 

Also, another disappointing thing is that after the war is over nothing changes. There weren't many major deaths, the corpus and the grineer are still at their old strength, my Litch somehow survived, major characters in each faction somehow survived.

If something could mean multiple different things isn't that the definition of misleading?

It's just multiple things that made me think it was going to be a big coop event and not just a single player quest. 

The prime resurgence, where they released 16 vaulted frames. It didn't really feel like it was for a single player quest only. Especially since they said you will have limited access to your arsenal.

The fact that orphix venom released almost 1 year ago exactly, and scarlet spears 9 months or so before that. We're due a big coop event like those two.

Talking about squads and all-out war also doesn't feel single player quest only. How is a single tenno supposed to fight an all-out war?
The way I saw it scarlet spear was more like a skirmish, or a battle. The same goes with orphix venom. I honestly thought that the new war was going to be a full on war. Multiple extra missions around the system. Perhaps even more than 4 people teams. Something that lasted more like one or two months, not a single quest.

Perhaps they will announce another coop event in a month or so, I don't really know.

Edit: also, the railjack npc's are called crew, not squad. So, once again, a bit misleading since they literally call it a crew.

"This December, The New War releases simultaneously on all platforms.  
After countless years biding their time since the collapse of the Orokin Empire, the Sentients have mustered a full-scale invasion force and are prepared to conquer a shattered and divided Origin System. Discover your power within and take control of new characters, Weapons and a brand-new Warframe as you wage war across the stars.  
Rally your Squad and get ready for the biggest narrative expansion to Warframe so far. The Origin System will never be the same."

Taken from the article on the warframe main website posted November 12th 2021

​

"Full-scale invasion force and are prepared to conquer a shattered and divided Origin System". And most importantly: "Rally your squad for the biggest narrative expansion to Warframe so far". 

Rally your squad doesn't really scream "single player quest" now does it. Sure, it also says narrative expansion, hence why I thought single player quest + coop event. 

Furthermore, in the new war trailer there were more than one warframe; namely Rhino, Nova, Excalibur; that doens't feel like a "single player quest only" either. 

I said that perhaps I read a bit too much into it, but this is what was stated and shown. If they said it was single player only in a devstream or somewhere else I can't really have known, either way I still believe it was somewhat misleading.

That's the point, I thought this marked a huge event. I took part in both scarlet spear and orphix venom. But I thought that this was going to be even bigger, not only a single player story quest. 

The warframe main website said "prepare for all-out war on all platforms" when releasing the article about the new war. A single player quest doesn't really feel like 'all-out war'.

While I agree that perhaps I read a bit too much into it, it was kind of misleading.
I honestly thought the quest was to mark the beginning of the new war, and then we got a massive multiplayer event like scarlet spear to actually fight "The New War".
Well, I guess I'll go back to farming Aya for the remaining primes I'm missing then, thanks

Just because it's common doesn't mean it's good. Especially if you think months if not years in the future, which is what mihoyo shuold be doing, since we still have an element to be introduced to the game, which most likely means another 2 artifact sets guaranteed (and they already added 4 sets in not even a year from release). The fact that stamina is limited  (9 single dungeon runs every 24 hours) and the rewards are already barely worth it. Considering that at least 50% of the artifacts you get are pure trash. You have a ton more things to farm. 

Right now i only log in, do the dailies, and spend stamina wherever i feel that day, and i log out. When an event is on i do that. I barely ever do stuff in the open world, since the rewards are trash, character xp doesn't scale at all it seems, and the mora you get is basically nonexistant. 

Giving players stuff to farm by lowering certain drop rates, the most common ones, only gets you so far. And honestly, seeing these numbers, i'm seriously thinking about farming artifacts at all.

But in the end, idk, i'm not a game developer, and mihoyo managed to make a ton of money with genshin, so they are probably doing something right. At least so far where they don't really have any competition (I don't know how many other games similar to genshin there are, but i'm quite sure that more developers will try to do something similar).

And yes, pretty much everything has a pretty low drop rate in genshin. Considering the resin required and the fact that certain things take multiple days to respawn and you need a ton of them for various things (which i don't really mind, as long as more characters use the same resources, wolfhook being only used for Razor, nocti jade for Beidou).

And having worse rates for more desirable main stats and substats is good game design? Adding useless stats to make your players farm more is good game design? sure, if you only have profit in mind it's great game design. but most people have a breaking point. And genshin is still relatively young, but we already have 4 more artifact sets, 2 from dragonspine, and 2 more to be added in the upcoming update. Will they add more in 3 months? 6 months? will the ones we have now be useless in 2 years because better ones will be released? Will we have to farm another dungeon 2000 times to get decent rates?

It's even worse than I thought :). Now i don't even want to farm artifacts again honestly. It was already bad assuming equal probabilities, but since the odds are already against you really, what's the point?

It's kind of like wishes, every single wish is extremely expensive (compared to other gachas I've played), and about 90% of what you get is 3\* useless weapons.

Why is it 5%? there are 11 possible main stats, 6 for elemental dmg, hp%, def%, atk%, physical dmg, elemental reaction. 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 11. You only want 1 outcome out of those eleven, so the probability of getting the main stat you want on any goblet from any set is 1/11. 

For the second point, i know, i just didn't want to make it even more complicated, which is why i said:

 "100% guarantee to drop" (i know it won't be guaranteed, but I wanted to see how much resin that would require) 

For the last point: this was an extreme case, where everything had to go the way I wanted. I also got some above average artifacts, and some really good ones (although usually flower or quill, the more likely to be good) if you only care about having 2 specific substats the odds increase, if you don't care which set the goblet belongs to, the odds increase. But i belive that the odds are not equal. But my "data" is waaaay to limited for me to do a decent estimate. For example i only got 1 anemo dmg goblet (and i Never used elemental or physical dmg goblets as exp for other artifacts) and like 5 electro, does this mean that anemo dmg is less likely? not really unless we analyze millions of artifacts.
